## Why This Is Asked
Security of supply chain in multi-tenant, multi-cloud clusters is critical; signing and pinning mitigates tampering.

## Key Concepts
- Image signing (Cosign, Sigstore)
- Digest pinning (@sha256:...)
- Admission policies (Gatekeeper, Kyverno)
- CI verification with cosign verify

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-image-digest-signature
spec:
  rules:
  - name: digest-pinned
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ['Deployment','StatefulSet','DaemonSet','Job','CronJob']
    validate:
      message: 'Image must be pinned to a digest and Cosign-signed'
      pattern:
        spec:
          template:
            metadata:
              annotations:
                cosignSig: 'true'
            spec:
              containers:
              - image: '*@sha256:*'
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical policy design for multi-tenant clusters spanning clouds, focusing on isolation, least privilege, and auditable control.

## Key Concepts

- Namespace labeling, per-tenant RBAC

## Code Example
```yaml
# Kyverno example: require tenant label and non-root containers
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-isolation
spec:
  validationFailureAction: enforce
  rules:
  - name: require-tenant-label
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Namespace"]
    validate:
      message: "Namespace must have label tenant"
      pattern:
        metadata:

            'tenant': '*'

            spec:
              securityContext:

              containers:
              - securityContext:
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              hostNetwork: false
              volumes: [{}, ...]
```

```yaml
name: MigrateProvenanceGate
on: push
jobs:
```

## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of policy as code, basic Kubernetes security posture, and simple automation.

## Key Concepts

- Kyverno policy definitions
- Pod securityContext fields
- Image provenance enforcement

## Code Example

```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: secure-pods
spec:
  validationFailureAction: enforce
  rules:
  - name: ensure-secure-context
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: [Pod]
        namespaces: [secure]
    validate:
      message: SecurityContext must be non-root, readOnlyRootFilesystem, no privileged, drop ALL
      pattern:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: "*"
            securityContext:
              runAsNonRoot: true
              runAsUser: 1000
              allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
              readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
              capabilities:
                drop:
                - ALL
  - name: image-policy
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: [Pod]
        namespaces: [secure]
    validate:
      message: Image must come from allowed registry
      pattern:
        spec:
          containers:
          - image: example.com/secure/*
  - name: image-pull-policy
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: [Pod]
        namespaces: [secure]
    validate:
      message: imagePullPolicy must be Always
      pattern:
        spec:
          containers:
          - imagePullPolicy: Always
```

```yaml
    validate:
      message: "hostNetwork/hostPath/privileged not allowed"
      pattern:
        spec:
          hostNetwork: False
        volumes: []
```
